candidates.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5 on AWS: Anthropic’s most capable Opus model
candidates.summary: This post covers Opus 5’s improvements and practical guidance for AI engineers integrating the model into agentic systems and production inference workloads on Amazon Bedrock. See the documentation for Claude Platform on AWS.

candidates.title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
candidates.summary: The acquisition brings Poke’s conversational style and interaction model to Cognition’s coding agent Devin, reflecting a growing belief that how AI assistants interact with users is as important as the models powering them.
